headline: Paderborn narrow favourites as in-form Hamburg come to town
summary: Two teams in very different form meet on Saturday, and the market keeps the home side just in front. Hamburger SV have won 3 straight league games, yet that run has covered a defence that has conceded 13 goals, including two 0-5 defeats in September. Paderborn are 16th with 5 points and drew 2-2 at Werder Bremen last weekend after leading. Across the market average, Paderborn are 39.7% to win and Hamburg 34.0%, separated by only 0.12 of a goal. The fair total is 2.96 goals.
read: Paderborn are 16th with one win in five and host an HSV side on a three-match winning run, yet the market still makes the home team narrow favourites at 39.7%. Paderborn concede 2.04 expected goals a game and HSV have shipped 13 goals in six, so the market expects about three goals, with both teams scoring more likely than not at 62.5%.

facts.fact: Paderborn are narrow home favourites at 39.7% to win, with HSV at 34.0%.
facts.meaning: The market sees a near coin-flip: home advantage is the only thing putting the home side ahead of a team with far better recent results.

facts.fact: HSV arrive on a three-match winning run in the Bundesliga, the latest a 1-0 home win over Stuttgart.
facts.meaning: They come in as the form team of the two, yet are still priced as slight away underdogs.

facts.fact: Paderborn led 2-0 at Werder Bremen on Saturday and drew 2-2, and are described as under pressure before this game.
facts.meaning: Paderborn are 16th with one win in five, so a home game against a form side is one they badly need something from.

facts.fact: HSV have conceded 13 goals in six league games, including two 0-5 defeats.
facts.meaning: Their winning run has masked a defence that gets taken apart — a fragility the market is pricing by keeping HSV at only 34%.

facts.fact: Paderborn are conceding 2.04 expected goals per game this season.
facts.meaning: They give up good chances consistently, so their games tend to be open rather than controlled.

facts.fact: Paderborn have won three and drawn two of their last five meetings with HSV.
facts.meaning: Paderborn have not lost to HSV in this run, which is a big part of why they are still the favourites here.

facts.fact: The market's fair handicap line is -0.12 goals — Paderborn are rated barely a tenth of a goal better than HSV.
The market's fair total line is 2.96 goals — a game of about three goals.
facts.meaning: Over 3.0 is close to a coin-flip, so a 2-1 or 3-1 kind of game rather than a tight 1-0.

sources.fact: Paderborn are under pressure going into the match, having drawn 2-2 with Werder Bremen after leading 2-0.
29 of Paderborn's 30 senior squad players trained on Wednesday, with only Oliver Batista Meier absent.
Nyamekye Awortwie-Grant has completed his first full training session with Paderborn in several months as he steps up his comeback.
Paderborn led 2-0 at Werder Bremen but were pegged back to 2-2, a result that highlighted the promoted side's remaining weaknesses.
Rayan Philippe, who celebrates his 26th birthday on Friday, faces his former club HSV on Saturday.
Steffen Tigges made his first Paderborn start in eight months at Bremen and rewarded the choice by scoring.
Hamburger SV are on a three-match winning run, which they aim to extend at Paderborn.
Albert Sambi Lokonga has resumed full training after a muscular problem and is on track to return to the HSV squad against Paderborn, though he may not start immediately.
